# Issue #41: `slugify` produces double hyphens and trailing hyphens

`slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` but should return `"hello-world"`.
Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

Please fix `textkit/slug.py`. Do not change the public signature.

content:
All tests pass. The fix adds two steps after the initial replacement:

1. Collapse consecutive hyphens into a single hyphen using `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`.
2. Strip leading/trailing hyphens with `text.strip("-")`.

This ensures `slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello-world"` and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"

arguments.summary: Fixed slugify to collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into one and strip leading/trailing hyphens, so that inputs like "Hello,  World!" and "--a--b--" produce clean output like "hello-world" and "a-b".
